purpose: py_internal.create_repo_mapping_manifest(ctx=, runfiles=, output=) (rules/python/PyBuiltins.java:157-181 via builtins_bzl/common/python/py_internal.bzl): a RepoMappingManifestAction (analysis/RepoMappingManifestAction.java, a file write) of the given runfiles to `output`, over the target's transitive packages (RuleContext.getTransitivePackagesForRunfileRepoMappingManifest), returning None; BuiltinFunction binding (three named-only parameters ctx/runfiles/File). Motivation: after the py_internal ctx helpers, `build --nobuild //src/beyondwork.ai/tools/...` on ~/code stopped at `analysis of @@rules_pkg+//pkg/private/tar:build_tar: ... error: py_internal.create_repo_mapping_manifest is not implemented in the native profile (analysis-time Python API)` (rules_python 1.7.0 py_executable.bzl:842, the `<name>.zip.repo_mapping` of `_create_zip_file`), and `//src/beyondwork.ai/...` at //src/python/tools/docxgen:docxgen.

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (the genuine platforms 1.0.0 module extracted into `platforms` from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents].
comparison (tests/py_repo_mapping.rs, li: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; a failing case's genuine message (the `Error in <callable>: ` / `Error: ` Starlark text, else the rule error following an empty `in KIND rule L: ` line, else the first ERROR message) is contained in native stderr; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal; a `test` case's stdout (the test summary, ` in N.Ns` run times as ` in <T>s`) equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: The manifest lists `source,apparent,canonical` lines of the transitive repositories' mappings whose canonical repository has runfiles artifacts: a main-repository file gives `,py_repo_mapping,_main` (the root module's own name); an external module's file adds `,other,ext+` (its repo_name in the main repository) and `ext+,ext,ext+` (its own mapping); a dependency's default runfiles count; empty runfiles give an empty file; symlink targets do not count, a symlink below the workspace counts as the main repository, a root symlink's first segment only when it is a canonical repository name; --incompatible_compact_repo_mapping_manifest changes nothing here. The function returns None.

Binding errors are the Java builtin's (`Error in create_repo_mapping_manifest: create_repo_mapping_manifest() got unexpected positional argument`, `in call to create_repo_mapping_manifest(), parameter 'ctx' got value of type 'NoneType', want 'ctx'`, `... 'runfiles' got value of type 'list', want 'runfiles'`, `... 'output' got value of type 'string', want 'File'`, `got unexpected keyword argument 'runfile' (did you mean 'runfiles'?)`); a missing parameter crashes Bazel 9.3 (FATAL, exit 37, the `unbound` default reaches PyBuiltins.repoMappingAction).
known_divergences: Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`), no INFO lines, and Starlark errors in its own traceback format without the @_builtins wrapper frame (the messages are Bazel's).
Declared divergence bad_missing: see the case.
Native is passed --experimental-builtin-modules in every case (as in the other paired fixtures).
